props.name: series
props.description: Series of points with a `value` sizing their bubble (area ∝ value)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: xAxis
props.description: X axis

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Y axis

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the pointer

props.name: annotations
props.description: Background areas and reference lines

props.name: interaction
props.description: Zoom (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, pinch), pan (drag), double-click reset and keyboard navigation; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes)

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

props.name: minSize
props.description: Diameter in pixels of the smallest bubbles

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Diameter in pixels of the largest value

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Value drawn with `maxSize` (share a scale between charts); the largest value by default

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) points change

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called when a point (or bar) is clicked

events.name: onPlotClick
events.description: Called when the plot area is clicked where there is no point

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

events.name: onRendererChange
events.description: Called with the backend once it is ready (and when it falls back after a GPU loss)

examples.title: Marketing campaigns
examples.description: Campaigns by launch date (xAxis.type: "time") and return on ad spend, sized by budget, one series per channel; a line annotation marks the break-even and the legend items toggle the channels.

examples.title: Countries
examples.description: GDP per capita against life expectancy, the bubbles sized by population and colored by continent; valueName and format name and format the value in the tooltip.

examples.title: Log scale
examples.description: Incomes from $900 to $140k: xAxis.type: "log" spreads them evenly (×10 is the same distance anywhere) with ticks at 1, 2 and 5 of each decade. The default range snaps to the closest 1, 2 or 5 × 10^k bounds around the data ($500 to $200k) instead of whole decades; xAxis.min / max override it. Annotations and the tooltip use dollars, and onZoom reports the visible range in dollars, not in logarithms (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or a pinch zooms).

examples.title: Sales pipeline
examples.description: Open deals by days in the pipeline and win probability, sized by amount; onPointClick receives the value of the clicked bubble.

examples.title: Animated years
examples.description: Fertility against life expectancy from 1990 to 2025, played one year at a time with setInterval (cleared on pause and unmount). Fixed axis ranges and a constant maxValue keep the frames comparable, and a text annotation writes the year.

examples.title: Product portfolio
examples.description: Market share, market growth and revenue of the products, split in four quadrants by two reference lines; showLabels writes the names around the bubbles.

examples.title: Risk matrix
examples.description: Project risks placed by likelihood and impact on a 5 × 5 grid, sized by their cost exposure; open-ended rect annotations shade the low and high zones and renderTooltip computes the risk score.

examples.title: Shared size scale
examples.description: Two charts compare the store regions of two years. With the same maxValue, a given revenue gets the same area in both charts; without it, each chart sizes its bubbles from its own largest value.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
